scenarios.name: Activate an already open part through the Open dialog

scenario_steps.name: a saved part is open in the MCAD Software
a different drawing document is active
the open part's exact file location is known
`fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is the active drawing
the user presses Control+O and chooses the already open part at that location
the existing part document tab becomes active
no additional document tab is created
